roles.title: Senior Product Manager - Xsolla Ads & Rewards

bullets: Work directly with the company’s Head of Product, Ads B2C as part of a new and growing B2C product team
Help to evolve and optimize our recently-launched consumer app
Design and leverage analytics and A/B testing to monitor app performance, tune mechanics, optimize conversion and identify new features to impact KPIs
Create and maintain product roadmaps, feature backlogs and product documentation such as PRDs, user stories, user flows, logic flows, and functional specifications, leveraging AI…
Anticipate bottlenecks, provide support for escalation management, make tradeoffs, balance the business needs versus technical and resource constraints
Own the look and feel of every ad unit in the offerwall: offer cards, detail pages, video, playables, interstitials, and the reward flow.
Set creative standards for advertisers and publishers: layouts, asset specs, safe areas, aspect ratios, and branding rules.
Balance three groups who want different things: players want a clean experience, publishers want it to match their game, and advertisers want their brand shown properly.
Define how we support VAST, HTML and MRAID , and OpenRTB Native inside the offerwall, across Web, iOS, Android, and Unity.
Write the requirements for format support: which VAST events we track, which MRAID calls we allow, and how Native assets map into our own templates.
Research and discovery. Get to know both sides of the XPN marketplace: the game publishers running creator campaigns and the creators bringing those campaigns to life. Talk with…
Coordinate the roadmap. Work with the Product Director to turn insights into priorities. Bring ideas and recommendations, balance publisher and creator needs, and help build a…
Write product requirements. Turn ideas into clear, well-scoped PRDs that give design and engineering what they need to build with confidence.
Manage delivery. Organize the work in Jira and keep design, engineering, and QA aligned and moving from kickoff through release.
Track what matters. Define and follow the metrics that show how XPN is working for publishers and creators, and use them to guide what we build next.

roles.title: Senior Technical Product Manager, App Performance Advertising

Set the objective the ranker optimises for, the constraints it works inside, and the guardrails and kill conditions that bound it. The target is eCPM today; what comes next is…
Own the metric definitions the whole team measures against, and settle the definitional questions that change the answer: gross against publisher-side RPU, app-load against…
Collaborate with on ML frameworks, experiment design, hold-outs, including pre-registered decision rules, power calculations, sample-ratio-mismatch checks, A/A validation…
Collaborate with DS on readouts to evaluate model performace and readouts to business stakeholders readout: what the model did, what it cost, and what happens next.
Research and discovery. Study competitors, interview publishers and partners to uncover their needs, and dig into subscriber and payment data to find what's worth building.
Collect requirements and design features. Turn findings into clear requirements and feature designs.
